# Documentation index

Repository-owned code, migrations, tests, and the documents below are the source of truth for `ms-go-statistic`.

- [Architecture](architecture.md): ownership, layers, data flow, and trust boundaries.
- [HTTP and WebSocket](http-and-websocket.md): routes, identity headers, request shapes, summaries, and current transport limits.
- [Storage and delivery](storage-and-delivery.md): event allowlist, in-memory acceptance, ClickHouse schema, failure behavior, and summary semantics.
- [Native development](native-development.md): host-process Statistic with the optional shared ClickHouse profile and shared JetStream.

Machine-readable mirrors live under `.ai/contracts`. Update implementation, tests, owned docs, and the corresponding mirror together when an observable contract changes.
